title: AdamX: Cosine similarity meets gradient descent
abstract: arXiv:2609.11867v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce AdamX, a first-order optimizer that incorporates cosine similarity as an adaptive mechanism for controlling update magnitudes. The proposed method is scalable, model-agnostic, and straightforward to integrate into existing training pipelines. We further introduce a variance rectification scheme that promotes smoother optimization during the early stages of training. Overall, we provide empirical evidence that AdamX achieves competitive convergence rates across a range of benchmark datasets and architectures. Performance is evaluated in terms of the number of epochs required to reach predefined performance thresholds under a fixed hyperparameter budget. Code and Experiments available at: https://github.com/FranciscoCaldas/adamX.

translated_title: AdamX：当余弦相似度遇上梯度下降
translated_abstract: 我们提出了AdamX，这是一种一阶优化器，它将余弦相似度作为自适应机制来控制更新幅度。所提出的方法具有可扩展性、模型无关性，并且易于集成到现有的训练流程中。我们还进一步引入了一种方差校正方案，以促进训练早期阶段更平滑的优化。总体而言，我们提供了实证证据，表明AdamX在一系列基准数据集和模型架构上都取得了具有竞争力的收敛速度。性能评估基于在固定超参数预算下达到预定性能阈值所需的训练轮数（epoch）。代码和实验可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/FranciscoCaldas/adamX。
tldr: AdamX是一种将余弦相似度作为自适应机制来控制更新幅度的新型一阶优化器，配合方差校正方案实现训练早期更平滑的优化，在多种基准数据集和模型架构上均取得了具有竞争力的收敛速度。
en_tdlr: AdamX is a first-order optimizer that uses cosine similarity as an adaptive mechanism to control update magnitudes, achieving competitive convergence rates across various benchmark datasets and architectures, with a variance rectification scheme promoting smoother early-stage training.
